name: micro_oiquad
description: 12 Binance-metrics majors: fade 24h moves made on FALLING open interest (short covering / long liquidation) - time-series and cross-sectional variants, 6h decisions, vol-targeted.
mechanism: A price move carried by positions CLOSING (OI down) is forced/one-off flow with no new conviction behind it and tends to give back; a move on OPENING positions (OI up) carries information and persists.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: Metrics from 2021-12: 365d training windows, OOS starts 2022-12.
The TS interaction passed the gate at 72h only (train |t| 1.36); the XS form at 6h/24h. Weak, multiple-tested evidence.
Live OI: Bybit tickers openInterestValue (venue differs from the Binance history used here).
Parameter- and cost-fragile: do not deploy on this evidence.
Verdict downgraded for fragility: a +/-1-step neighbour has negative dev Sharpe; dev Sharpe with 2x fees is 0.16
screen_evidence: TS interaction r24 x 1[dOI24<0] Driscoll-Kraay t train/test -1.36/-2.18 at 72h only (6h -1.24/-1.70, 24h -1.18/-0.84). XS FM form -2.59/-2.16 at 24h.
bug_hunt: Fragile: FROZEN needs dOI24 <= -1 sigma; with thr=0 the dev Sharpe is -0.59. The XS variants have train Sharpe -3.8 / -2.4.
Cost-fragile: 2x fees -> dev Sharpe 0.16, extra 6h lag -> 0.16 (from 0.52).
Random-timing 'runs' null ignored for the verdict (null turnover 793x/yr vs 417x).

notes: null_secondary ignored for the verdict: runs-null turnover 793 vs strategy 417
verdict_inputs.fragility_downgrade: a +/-1-step neighbour has negative dev Sharpe; dev Sharpe with 2x fees is 0.16

verdict_rule:
Family-E verdict rule (applied identically to every module):
      p_used = the LARGER p-value of the two nulls, ignoring a random-timing 'runs' null whose
               mean turnover is > 1.5x the strategy's (the shuffled continuous weights then pay
               far more costs, which biases that null DOWN - see lab_bugs_found).
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, deflated Sharpe (grid trials) >= 0.9 and
                 >= 60% of OOS calendar years positive.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.
      fails    : otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): any +/-1 grid-step neighbour of FROZEN with a negative
      dev Sharpe, or a dev Sharpe below 0.25 when fees are doubled (robustness_dev_frozen).
